messages:
viv: publishbot tried promoting a new image to staging but deploy-bot blocked it due to provenance timestamp skew on the attestation :hourglass:
deploy-bot: block reason: provenance.cosign_kms_ts=2024-10-27T18:20:00Z for digest sha256:7f1a...de33 (allowed-grace=36h)
jules: that timestamp is older than the mirror rotation window. seen this when cross-region KMS keys rotate and mirror attestations lag
ram: low-risk path is to pin staging to last-known-good digest and coordinate a republish with a fresh cosign attestation from the EU mirror key
viv: agree. plan: 1) open short change window and lock staging lane 2) pin services to digest sha256:11aa...cc99 3) ops republish to staging-temp with correct labels/attestation 4) promote + smoke tests then unpin 5) publish a release-note addendum
ops-bot: created ticket RB-4333 and attached label "provenance-resync"
release-coordinator: please include a release-note snippet that explicitly lists the pinned digest and new digest, and call out downstream clients that use floating tags
ram: lock command: `deployctl lock --lane=staging --duration=12m --reason="provenance resync; pin during republish RB-4333"`
viv: example pin: `redwoodctl service pin --service=api-staging --digest=sha256:11aa...cc99 --note="pin during RB-4333 resync"`
jules: I'll take the republish. pushing to staging-temp and will cosign with mirror KMS after push; will add labels: provenance.mirror=eu-west-1, provenance.resynced_by=jules, provenance.tool=publishbot-2
(90s)
jules: push done -> new digest sha256:f9b2...44ee. cosign attestation kms_ts=2024-11-07T06:45:00Z. uploading provenance metadata now
ops-bot: audit: user=jules action=republish target=staging-temp digest=sha256:f9b2...44ee ticket=RB-4333
deploy-bot: promoting staging-temp -> staging
deploy-bot: promote succeeded; smoke tests: login, payments, background-worker all pass :white_check_mark:
viv: waiting 3m observation then unpin and release lock
release-coordinator: release-note addendum posted: "hotfix: pinned staging to sha256:11aa...cc99 during provenance resync; new image sha256:f9b2...44ee promoted after resync (RB-4333). Downstream clients using floating tags should verify manifest digests or pin by digest."
ram: filing follow-up ORG-2366 to add a monitor that alerts when mirror attestations are older than 18h after KMS rotation and to automate a soft-pause of promotions during rotations
viv: thanks all — closing once RB-4333 is updated and the release-notes channel acked. :thumbsup:
